# SoftwareHow

> > Free online tools for image editing, compression, and manipulation without signup or installation required.

SoftwareHow provides a collection of browser-based utilities focused on image processing and media tools. The platform emphasizes accessibility with no-signup-required tools that handle common tasks like splitting images, batch compression, and social media optimization.

## Image Processing Tools

- [Free Online Image Splitter: Cut Photo in Half or Pieces](https://www.softwarehow.com/image-splitter): Free online tool to split photos horizontally, vertically, or both with preview
- [Bulk Image Compressor Online (Reduce Image Sizes Fast)](https://www.softwarehow.com/bulk-image-compressor): Batch compress images with up to 90% reduction across all formats
- [Instagram Grid Maker & Image Splitter (Free Online Tool)](https://www.softwarehow.com/image-splitter/instagram): Free Instagram grid maker to split photos into custom grid layouts
